candidatesAccepted.summary: A plain hotel in Ljubljana fits the roughest night you accept and a comfortable budget. Ages and access needs were not answered, so I could not account for them; confirm accessibility before booking.

candidatesAccepted.summary: A plain hotel in Trieste matches the roughest night you accept and a comfortable budget. Ages and access needs were not answered, so I could not account for them; confirm accessibility before booking.

candidatesAccepted.title: Schönbrunn Palace guided tour
candidatesAccepted.summary: A Habsburg summer residence with rooms you can walk through at your own pace, a good anchor for a Vienna stay. Ages and access needs were not answered, so check stair and walking requirements before booking.

candidatesAccepted.title: Ljubljana Castle hilltop visit
candidatesAccepted.summary: A castle on a hill above the old town, reached by funicular or a walk, with views over the city and its river. Access needs were not answered, so the walking route may not suit everyone.

candidatesAccepted.title: Miramare Castle and park
candidatesAccepted.summary: A seaside castle on the Gulf of Trieste set in a large park, a relaxed half-day that suits a moderate effort level. I could not confirm current opening hours or the season, so check before you go.

candidatesAccepted.title: Traditional Viennese wine tavern evening
candidatesAccepted.summary: A relaxed evening in a neighbourhood wine tavern serving Austrian home cooking and local wine, a natural first meal in Vienna. The party did not say what they cannot eat, so I could not account for any restrictions and this kind of place may not suit them; please check the menu before going.

candidatesAccepted.title: Slovenian kitchen dinner
candidatesAccepted.summary: A dinner at a traditional Slovenian restaurant, with regional dishes such as štruklji and grilled meats, suited to a comfortable budget. Dietary needs were not answered, so I could not account for them; the menu should be checked before ordering.

candidatesAccepted.title: Seafood lunch by the harbour
candidatesAccepted.summary: A casual lunch of Adriatic seafood and Friulian-influenced dishes near the Trieste waterfront, a fitting meal for a port city. Restrictions were not answered, so I could not account for them, and the party should confirm ingredients with the kitchen.

candidatesAccepted.title: Check the rail pass versus point-to-point fares
candidatesAccepted.summary: The trains between Vienna, Ljubljana and Trieste are the spine of this plan, so compare a flexible rail pass against booking each leg separately before fixing the route. I have not checked current fare rules or availability, and I could not account for the travellers' ages, which can change discount eligibility.

candidatesAccepted.title: Mobile data plan for three countries
candidatesAccepted.summary: Connectivity for Austria, Slovenia and Italy can be arranged with a regional eSIM or a local prepaid SIM, which matters for train tickets and maps on the move. I have not checked current plan prices or whether they cover all three countries, so treat the band as a rough guess.

candidatesAccepted.title: Trip insurance covering rail disruption
candidatesAccepted.summary: Travel insurance that covers cancelled or missed trains and changed bookings protects a plan built on three separate train legs. I could not account for access needs or ages, so medical cover cannot be sized from what I know, and I am not confirming any policy covers this trip.
